  IS_SAME({fldptOqHNXJK8xhpf}, TODAY(), 'day'),
  "Today",
  IF(
    IS_SAME({fldptOqHNXJK8xhpf}, DATEADD(TODAY(), 1, 'day'), 'day'),

    IF(
      AND(
        IS_AFTER({fldptOqHNXJK8xhpf}, DATEADD(TODAY(), 1, 'day')),

    )
  )
)
